source_observations.observation: Two neuter dual horn examples, a transfer to the animal and an explicit qualification that these are conventional quality terms.
Four prefix formations and separately specified dust, animal place, flock, spread, two, six, oil and field relations.

source_observations.locator: Kaumudī with Bālā, digital page 36, supplements under 5.2.29
source_observations.observation: Keeps tailac with oily product and lists the two affix choices on the field input.
Organizes the livestock and field supplements explicitly. Its oil example has a different spelling of the first member than the frozen Kāśikā.
Breadth is predicated of the approaching Jāmadagnya with a locative of bodily respect. The other Rāma belongs to the surrounding episode.
Explicitly cites śaṅkaṭac and glosses breadth of chest. Gives iṇ with ā and laṭ, past āgatavān as gloss, and 6.1.89 for aiti.
The person Viśāla and city Viśālā stand in distinct name clauses. The following verse names his son.
The city-founding clause independently locates the passage despite differing sarga numbering.

source_observations.observation: Lexical address of the sic in the play. Its initial upadeśa spelling differs from the working stem.
Specifically retains retroflexion across the augment aṭ for the ensuing prescribed range. Gives prefix plus augment examples.
The list explicitly includes sic. A qualifying preverb is required.
The historical report can have morphological laṭ with sma. Its temporal value has a distinct history from the ending.
